title: Thread/query args
description: Arguments for Thread/query (RFC 8621 §2.3 / RFC 8620 §5.5). Returns a sorted, filtered list of Thread ids.

accountId.description: The account to query threads in.

filter.description: Conditions to filter threads. See RFC 8621 for filter conditions.

sort.description: List of Comparator objects specifying sort order.

position.description: Zero-based index of first result to return.

anchor.description: Id of an item to anchor the result window on.

limit.description: Maximum number of ids to return.

calculateTotal.description: If true, return total count of results.
